name: Market Claim
definition: Processes that reallocate corporate action proceeds to the entitled party and that compensate financial penalties or indirect costs due to late delivery or payment.

MarketClaimAmount.name: Market Claim Amount
MarketClaimAmount.definition: Amount of money resulting from a market claim.

MarketClaimTrackingEndDate.name: Market Claim Tracking End Date
MarketClaimTrackingEndDate.definition: Date by which the depository stops monitoring activities of the event, for instance, accounting and tracking activities for due bills end.

RelatedCorporateEvent.name: Related Corporate Event
RelatedCorporateEvent.definition: Corporate event for which market claim information is provided.
